name: Home Alone with Brad
source:
Brad, the sporty jock from Purp High School, is having difficulty in surviving on his own. Luckily, the ever reliable class rep Kim came to help.

Will Kim be able to satisfy Brad in all his needs?

Or will Brad demand more than what Kim's expected?
